My dear [Mrs Baker](/person/2075)
Here is your New Zealand paper. I am very sorry I have not been able to use it in the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52), but I get more and more in arrears of MS, and am shocked at the way thinks [sic] lie by

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
